web.description:
This list contains the top 50 accounts with the most followers on the social media platform [X, formerly and commonly known as Twitter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitter). As of March2026[[update]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_most-followed_X_accounts&action=edit), [Elon Musk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elon_Musk), the owner of the website, has the most-followed account with over 236 million followers. Other notable figures such as Presidents [Barack Obama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama) and [Donald Trump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump), Prime Minister [Narendra Modi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Narendra_Modi) and [Cristiano Ronaldo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cristiano_Ronaldo) each have over 100 million followers. [Katy Perry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katy_Perry) was the first person to surpass the 100 million follower milestone, in June 2017. ## List | Username | Owner | Followers

It makes sense that [Elon Musk](https://x.com/elonmusk) is the most-followed X/Twitter account — he bought the platform in 2022, and is the person behind the rebrand. Celebrated for driving companies like Tesla and SpaceX into the public eye, he’s now equally famous for controversial X posts and public speaking.

Musk’s brief position in the US government gave his posts extra sway with users, regardless of their opinion on the man himself. All of this makes him the only X/Twitter account with more than 200 million followers.
